verdict.description: Verdict on whether the flagged incident holds up against ordinary-editing explanations: survives, benign, or unclear.

benign_explanation.description: The ordinary editing category that explains the incident, or none if verdict is survives.

reason.description: 1 to 3 English sentences stating the strongest benign reading and why it does or does not hold.

would_change_mind.description: One English sentence stating the concrete evidence that would flip the verdict.

quoted.description: 0 to 3 spans copied verbatim from the inputs that the reason relies on.
